brief_rationale: All eight responsibility-chain items are met with no in-chain errors. The doctor correctly identified the preterm infant context, systematically screened for red flags, gave appropriate triage guidance, avoided harmful misdiagnosis, provided safe interim medication guidance with verification pathway, addressed follow-up and other diagnoses, and obtained teach-back confirmation. Two high-order points are completed: HO1 (anxiety-adapted communication) and HO4 (repairing incomplete information when family conflated medications and confused dosage). HO2 and HO3 were triggered but not completed. Closure is valid with safe, executable plan.

closure_assessment.explanation: The episode concludes with a bounded home observation plan: clear red flag criteria for immediate emergency visit, interim medication guidance (AD only today pending verification), temperature monitoring guidance, and follow-up pathway (call neonatology nurse station tomorrow). Family demonstrates accurate teach-back of all critical safety points and medication verification plan.
